messages.author: 73cb64201fa2417b
messages.subject: ipv6 support roadmap
parts:
I cannot find any reference to a timeline for supporting ipv6 with shiny/shiny-server. Are there any known plans?

tia
Tim

messages.author: 732e6d129a64817d
messages.subject: Re: ipv6 support roadmap
parts:
No response. But if anyone is interested, simply ignoring the checks for ipv4 addresses, and directly stuffing an ipv6 one into server.listen in server.js in 0.3.6. worked for me.

As I don't know why the ipv4 checks are there, I don't feel comfortable proposing a patch :-)

fwiw, my usecase is using shiny-server as part of a monitoring tool on solar panels on a standalone computer. Using ipv6, it's really easy to route directly to shiny, rather than have to faff with ipv4 NAT rules.  Shiny's quite easy to add as a front end to logged data.

Tim

messages.author: 73cb64201fa2417b
messages.subject: Re: ipv6 support roadmap
parts:
As an update, I recently updated my shiny-server, and ipv6 access no longer works as the code is rich in ipv4 parsing :-(

I think that it's a shame that IPv6 consideration didn't make it in sooner as the major social media sites are finding that it's a faster and more stable access route.

Instant legacy :-(
